skill.description: Guided workflow for authorized web application, API, and infrastructure security assessments.

security_audit.summary: Most static external-command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks in documentation. The Metasploit reference is confirmed, and the workflow includes dual-use offensive testing steps that need stronger authorization and dependency controls.

remediation.suggestion: Remove Metasploit references or restrict them to approved lab environments with explicit authorization, scope, and safety limits.
Add mandatory authorization, target ownership, rate limits, test windows, and stop conditions before reconnaissance, fuzzing, or exploitation tasks.

remediation.issue: Referenced specialist skills are not pinned or reviewed
remediation.suggestion: List trusted sources and versions for each referenced skill, or require manual review before any external skill invocation.

content.value_statement: Security teams need a repeatable way to plan authorized assessments. This skill organizes reconnaissance, scanning, testing, hardening, and reporting steps.
actual_capabilities: Organizes security assessment work into reconnaissance, scanning, testing, hardening, and reporting phases.
Lists related specialist skills for OWASP, API, authentication, dependency, and hardening checks.
Provides copy-ready prompts for coordinating security testing tasks inside an AI coding tool.
Includes checklists for OWASP Top 10 and API security review coverage.
Defines quality gates for documenting findings, risk levels, remediation, and final reports.
limitations: Requires explicit authorization and a defined target scope before any testing begins.
Does not include executable scanners, exploit code, or validation logic by itself.
Relies on referenced specialist skills that must be reviewed separately before use.
Does not replace professional judgment, legal review, or organization-specific compliance controls.

use_cases.title: Plan a Web Security Audit
use_cases.description: Create a phase-based assessment plan for an authorized web application review.

use_cases.title: Coordinate API Security Testing
use_cases.description: Track authentication, authorization, rate limiting, input validation, and error handling checks.

use_cases.title: Prepare Remediation Reporting
use_cases.description: Turn confirmed findings into clear risk summaries, remediation steps, and quality gates.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Audit Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for an authorized assessment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan an authorized security audit for this application. Include scope, phases, evidence needed, and reporting checkpoints.

prompt_templates.title: Review API Controls
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to review API security controls. Focus on authentication, authorization, rate limits, validation, and error handling.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Organize these security findings by impact, exploitability, affected assets, remediation effort, and evidence quality.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Remediation Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this audit output into a remediation plan with owners, timelines, validation steps, and executive summary points.

output_examples.input: A team needs an authorized review plan for a customer portal.
output_examples.output: A phased plan covering scope confirmation, reconnaissance, vulnerability review, web testing, API checks, hardening tasks, and final reporting.

output_examples.input: An API assessment found weak authorization and missing rate limits.
output_examples.output: A prioritized finding summary with impact, affected endpoints, recommended fixes, validation steps, and reporting notes.

output_examples.input: A security lead needs final quality gates before delivery.
output_examples.output: A checklist confirming completed tests, captured evidence, assigned risk levels, remediation steps, and an executive-ready summary.

best_practices: Confirm written authorization, target scope, timing, and testing limits before using this workflow.
Review every referenced specialist skill before invocation, especially tools related to exploitation or reconnaissance.
Keep evidence, risk ratings, remediation advice, and retest results linked to each finding.
anti_patterns: Do not use the workflow against systems without explicit permission.
Do not invoke offensive testing tools before confirming legal scope and safety controls.
Do not publish findings without evidence, impact analysis, and practical remediation guidance.

faq.question: Does this skill run security scanners?
faq.answer: No. It is a workflow guide that coordinates phases and prompts. Referenced tools or skills must be reviewed separately.

faq.question: Can I use it for production systems?
faq.answer: Use it only with explicit authorization, approved test windows, and documented safety controls for production assets.

faq.question: Does it cover API security?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes API authentication, authorization, rate limiting, input validation, error handling, and reporting checks.

faq.question: Is this suitable for compliance work?
faq.answer: It can support assessment planning and evidence organization, but compliance mapping must follow your required standard.

faq.question: Does it include exploit code?
faq.answer: No. The skill text does not include exploit code, but it references offensive testing workflows that require strict controls.

faq.question: What should I review before installing it?
faq.answer: Review the Metasploit and penetration testing references, plus every referenced external skill, before using this workflow.
